thread.title: Apple's Warning And The Effects On Other Suppliers - Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL)

author: Patient Tech Investor
title: Apple's Warning And The Effects On Other Suppliers - Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL)
text:
Apple's Market Shaking Warning We wrote an article discussing the effect Cirrus Logic's ( CRUS ) updated guidance announced on December 3, 2018 meant for Apple ( AAPL ) iPhone sales. In one of our versions, we had included a statement that Apple would warn. Although we did finally exclude it, our belief that Apple had adjusted its inventory management scheme with Cirrus from yearly balancing to effectively quarter to quarter made Apple's original guidance too high.
At an average iPhone ASP close to $800, we expected Apple to miss its early estimates by $800/iPhone unit times 10 million units or at least by $8 billion. Apple's guidance announced on November 1st of $89-$93 billion, even from the high-end, suggested $85 billion. At $85 billion, Apple must warn, which it did on January 2nd giving a preliminary result of $84 billion. We expect Apple's final result to be slightly higher.
